lesson_title: VT+DD overlay cannot rescue redundant factor pairs (corr 0.943)
lesson: When the underlying 2-factor blend has cross-factor correlation of 0.943 (CR08 Volume-Price Divergence + D01 IdioVol), VT and DD overlays can only reduce MDD marginally (31.77% -> 26.76%) while destroying already-insufficient CAGR (7.98% -> 7.33%). The overlay optimization problem is fundamentally constrained: overlays manage risk but do not create alpha. With base SR 0.633 and negative IR, no overlay parameterization can elevate this to Grade A territory. The 4-variant S5 mutation experiment (S5, M1, M2, M3) across different VT/DD combinations confirms a flat SR surface (0.566-0.646) -- the parameter space is exhausted. Future lesson: when S3 orthogonality shows factor corr > 0.90, skip S5 overlay mutations entirely. The redundancy is structural and cannot be fixed by risk management.
actionable_rule: When S3 factor_mean_max_corr > 0.90 AND base SR < 0.80, SKIP all S5 overlay mutations. Redirect effort to factor substitution (replace one factor in the pair) or abandon the combination.
